hypotheses.reasoning: At 12:03:10 (#114), template-svc reloaded MAILER_API_KEY from the secrets store: version 17 went live and version 16 was revoked. Requests had been succeeding up to that point (#106, #110). Starting at 12:04:07, every send to the email provider got 401 Unauthorized (invalid API key) (#117, #122, #128). template-svc passed this up as a 502, notification-svc's TemplateClient.render failed on it (#130, #146), and the gateway returned 502 on POST /v1/notify (#121, #139, #144, #157). The key rotation was bad: the new key isn't valid at the provider, or the revocation happened before the new key took effect. The 401s come from the third-party mailer, so a problem on the provider's side with key validation is possible. But the errors start right after the local key rotation, which points to us, not them.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll MAILER_API_KEY back to a key that works: un-revoke v16 or check that v17 is registered and active with the mailer provider, then reload template-svc's secrets. Next, change the rotation process so the old key is revoked only after the new one has been confirmed working.
